data.title: Unemployment benefit ended from 1 September 2026
data.summary: The Agentur für Arbeit Musterbergen wrote on 27 August 2026 that your unemployment benefit (Arbeitslosengeld) ends on 1 September 2026 because you start insured employment. It will still pay €1,318.20 for August 2026.
data.explanation: Because you start a job subject to social insurance on 1 September 2026, your unemployment benefit is cancelled from that day. You will still receive €1,318.20 for August 2026. If you disagree, you may file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing or in person at the office; it must reach the agency within one month of notification. The app shows the deadline. If you agree, nothing more is needed. A counselling service can help if you are unsure.

items.quote: Er muss uns innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift erreichen (Agentur für Arbeit Musterbergen, Bahnhofstraße 12, 35037 Musterbergen).
items.action: If you disagree, file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing or in person at the Agentur für Arbeit Musterbergen.
items.consequence: After the deadline the decision becomes final.
